favorites.title: Some of My Favorite Dinosaurs
favorites.subtitle: Meet three of the most fascinating giants of the Mesozoic era.

allosaurus.description: An apex predator of the Jurassic, known for its large skull, sharp serrated teeth, and powerful claws. It was a fearsome hunter that likely preyed on large herbivores like sauropods.
allosaurus.funFact: It had relatively long arms compared to T-Rex, with claws up to 25 cm long!

oxalaia.description: Considered the largest carnivorous dinosaur in Brazil, this spinosaurid was a close relative of Spinosaurus and lived in semi-aquatic environments.
oxalaia.funFact: Its name honors the African deity Oxalá and the quilombos of Cajual Island, in Maranhão, where its fossils were found.

brachiosaurus.description: One of the most recognizable dinosaurs. Its front legs were significantly longer than its hind legs, creating a steeply inclined posture that, combined with its immensely long neck, made it a true giant of its time.
brachiosaurus.funFact: Its heart weighed about 400 kg and pumped blood up to 12 metres high!

timeline.title: Paleontological Timeline
timeline.subtitle: Journey through Earth's history - from geological events that shaped our planet to the archaeological discoveries that revealed the dinosaur world.

cretaceous_end.title: End-Cretaceous Mass Extinction
cretaceous_end.description: The asteroid impact that ended the age of dinosaurs. A massive asteroid struck Earth, causing global climate change and the extinction of non-avian dinosaurs.

cretaceous_start.title: Cretaceous Period Begins
cretaceous_start.description: The final period of the Mesozoic Era begins. Flowering plants appear and dinosaurs reach their peak diversity.

jurassic_start.title: Jurassic Period Begins
jurassic_start.description: The golden age of dinosaurs begins. Supercontinent Pangaea breaks apart, creating new ocean basins and climate patterns.

triassic_jurassic_extinction.title: Triassic–Jurassic Extinction Event
triassic_jurassic_extinction.description: A major extinction event that eliminated many competitors of dinosaurs, allowing them to become the dominant terrestrial vertebrates.

triassic_start.title: Triassic Period Begins
triassic_start.description: The first period of the Mesozoic Era. Early dinosaurs evolve and the supercontinent Pangaea dominates Earth's geography.

permian_extinction.title: Permian–Triassic Extinction
permian_extinction.description: The Great Dying — the most severe mass extinction in Earth's history. It set the stage for dinosaur evolution.
